job.title: Business Analyst (m/w/d)
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your Business Analyst role needs someone who turns business needs into clear IT requirements – my daily work at Rockwell Automation and Shell across e-commerce, ERP and master data. What I bring in concrete terms:

– Requirements, user stories and functional specifications
– Process mapping, gap analysis and UAT
– Integration and data analysis across SAP ERP, PIM and MDM

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Business Analyst | Techno-Functional | Requirements, Processes & System Integration
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional business analyst with 5+ years on enterprise e-commerce and integration landscapes (SAP Commerce Cloud, SAP ERP, PIM, MDM) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Analyses business requirements, writes user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications, maps processes, runs gap analysis and supports UAT. Investigates integration and data issues with international technical teams and brings hands-on understanding of APIs, data pipelines and SQL. Works agile with Jira and Confluence and uses AI tools extensively in analysis and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: MARKANT connects trade and industry with services where clean data and reliable processes are everything. My strongest work has been exactly there: master data, integrations and business requirements. Offenburg's proximity to Karlsruhe makes this a role I can commit to long term. My combination of hands-on platform depth and close work with business teams is exactly what I want to put to work for you.

en.subject: Application: Business Analyst
en.hook: A Business Analyst at MARKANT has to translate the needs of trade partners and business units into clear, workable IT solutions. That translation is my daily work: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I analyse requirements, write specifications and resolve integration issues between e-commerce, ERP and master data systems – with more than five years of hands-on technical experience behind it.

bullets.label: Requirements analysis
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications and translated them into SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Process mapping & UAT
bullets.text: Gathered business requirements with product owners and business teams, mapped processes and supported user acceptance testing (UAT).

bullets.label: Data & system integration
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee and built PIM data pipelines keeping product catalogs synchronized.

bullets.label: Data consistency
bullets.text: Engineered API migrations for customer account structures that improved system stability and data consistency.

en.logistics: Offenburg is within easy reach of my home in Karlsruhe. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can support your business and IT teams.
